## Personality

Despite appearing to be in good health, Esther is a hypochondriac who suffers from indigestion and spends significant time detailing her various aches and pains. She is described as a dear girl, though she lacks imagination and is prone to pursuing fads.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043), [v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)_
